author: TheCrazySof
body:
Yesterday June16,2015 Kleypex wrongfully warned me for "spamming". I do not have the proof but there are logs. Even he himself said it was a mistake and said he would try to remove the infraction. It never happened so I'm here to ask for my infraction to be removed.

Thanks, TheCrazySof
